scripts.server:dev: cd server && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd server && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && cd server && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && cd server && uv run ruff check .
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
